articles.summary: LONDON—September 30, 2026—nVent Electric plc (NYSE: NVT), a global leader in electrical connection and protection solutions, today announced the launch of the nVent ERICO Color Smart Ground Rod System, a color-coded copper-bonded grounding system designed to simplify product selection, reduce installation errors and improve productivity for contractors and distributors.
